# `Level`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Level — the `LogLevel` severity-tag ADT.

`LogLevel` is a reserved builtin type: its nullary constructors
(`debug` / `info` / `warn` / `error`) are the ONLY source of
`LogLevel` values.  Pass one to `Log.level` to configure the
runtime log severity.

## `debug`

```ipe
debug : LogLevel
```

Debug severity — the lowest level; verbose diagnostic output.

## `info`

```ipe
info : LogLevel
```

Info severity — normal operational messages.

## `warn`

```ipe
warn : LogLevel
```

Warn severity — recoverable unexpected conditions.

## `error`

```ipe
error : LogLevel
```

Error severity — failures that require attention.
